outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial deconvolution heatmaps overlaid on tissue images (micrographs), not a plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a box plot showing distribution statistics (median, quartiles, min/max) with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group, satisfying the requirement.
Panel C consists of GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points since overlaying points would make the line plot unreadable.

Panel D is a bar chart showing log2 fold change values for individual genes from DEG analysis with associated p-values, but no individual data points (e.g., per-spot or per-replicate values) are overlaid on the bars, so the underlying variability behind each fold-change estimate cannot be assessed.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrograph/photograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
